tools.name: balance
tools.description: Read-only verify credit balance for a workspace. Call this before a batch. Does not burn credits.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Verify one email. Cached repeats within 30 days are free. If credits are 0, returns payment_required with a checkout_url. Never invent results. unknown means the check did not finish.

tools.name: receipts
tools.description: List proof of spend and proof of checks for this workspace. Use this when the human asks what a charge paid for. Do not invent checkout session ids.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email · Public sink: verify_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email · Public sink: verify_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
